segments.segment_summary: A point-of-view shot follows two black cows as they walk through deep snow alongside a barn and enter it.

key_moments.caption: Two black cows walk through deep snow next to a fence and a barn.
One of the cows runs ahead and enters the barn.
The second cow follows the first into the barn.

segments.segment_summary: A man wearing a beanie and jacket talks to the camera while standing in the snow next to a barn, commenting on the time of day and the difficulty of walking in deep snow.

key_moments.caption: A man in a beanie talks to the camera about his father cleaning the yard.
The man walks and talks, expressing that he's out of breath from walking in the snow.
He smiles at the camera after commenting on being tired.

segments.segment_summary: A large yellow front-end loader is shown clearing deep snow from a yard or driveway, pushing it into a large pile.

key_moments.caption: The loader pushes a large bucketful of snow forward.
The loader lifts its bucket and dumps the snow onto a large pile.
The loader scoops up another load of snow to clear the path.

segments.segment_summary: An outro scene shows several cows eating from a trough in the snow, with a tractor and feed mixer in the background. Text overlays prompt viewers to follow on social media and thank them for watching.

key_moments.caption: A shot of cows eating from a trough with a text overlay for social media accounts.
The camera pans left to show more cows eating.
The text "Thanks for watching!" appears on the screen over the scene of cows eating.
